items.title: Boxer Reeves in stable but critical condition after suffering knockout
items.description: Boxer Lee reeves is in a "stable but critical condition" after suffering a knockout in his fight with Gary Cully at the 3Arena in Dublin on Saturday night.

items.title: Kuwaki pips Henseleit to major play-off win after extraordinary finish
items.description: Shiho Kuwaki snatched a dramatic play-off victory over Esther Henseleit after an extraordinary finish to the AIG Women’s Open, as Charley Hull and Lottie Woad fell short on the final day.

items.title: 'Oh my word!' | Henseleit sinks MONSTER birdie putt to force play-off
items.description: Esther Henseleit sunk a huge putt on the 18th to force a playoff in the AIG Women's Open.
